texts.summary: The Vicomte de Turenne to the Grand Master, 1 June 1528. Turenne reports on papal negotiations, revenge against the Florentines and the duke of Ferrara, and royal assistance; his postscript discusses Andrea Doria’s intended change of allegiance.
texts.note: The repository holds only the excerpt and translation in George Lasry's report (lasry_entry.md); his full transcription and decryption are his and not yet in the repository, and the ciphertext has not been transcribed here.
